CC @godotengine/rendering @godotengine/shaders 

According to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/99587#issuecomment-2496800112 the regression was introduced in 4.4.dev3.

There's a MRP linked in the OP.
And relevant reproduction steps in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/99587#issuecomment-2525255627 for a minimal reproducer. Sounds like a potential alignment/memory issue?

No crash with 4.4 dev2 but crashes with 4.4 dev3.

Bisected to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/83360

I suspect that this is a duplicate of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/76667. Basically the issue is that most GPUs only support 32 varyings. The shader from this issue uses 20 varyings and Godot reserves 14, so together they go over the limit. 

I think that some drivers are able to repurpose the reserved but unused varyings so they don't have the same issue. As I commented on https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/76667, the solution will be for us to validate the number of varyings used in user shaders since right now users can exceed the limit and crash their systems without having any feedback that they did something wrong. 

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/64948 is the same issue as well
